title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Exodus 37: Bezalel makes the ark, the mercy seat, the table, the lamp stand and the altar of incense.

questions.text: What was the length of the ark that Bezalel made?
questions.explanation: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; its length was two and a half cubits, and its width and height a cubit and a half.

questions.text: How did Bezalel overlay the ark with pure gold?
questions.explanation: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold around it.

questions.text: How were the two cherubim on the mercy seat made?
questions.explanation: He made two cherubim of gold, of beaten work, of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

answers.text: Carved from acacia wood and set on top of the ark
Cast in silver and fastened with rings
Of beaten gold, in one piece with the mercy seat
Woven into a cloth laid over the ark

questions.text: Which way were the faces of the cherubim turned?
questions.explanation: The cherubim's faces were toward one another; the faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

answers.text: Toward the east, where the sun rises
Toward the door of the tent
Upward, toward the heavens above the tent
Toward one another and toward the mercy seat

questions.text: How wide was the border that Bezalel made around the table?
questions.explanation: He made a border of a hand's width around it, and made a golden molding on its border.

answers.text: Half a cubit on each side

questions.text: Which of these was among the vessels made for the table?
questions.explanation: He made the vessels on the table - its dishes, its spoons, its bowls and its pitchers - of pure gold.

questions.text: What were the cups on the branches of the lamp stand made like?
questions.explanation: There were three cups made like almond blossoms in each branch, with a bud and a flower.

questions.text: How much gold was used for the lamp stand with all its vessels?
questions.explanation: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

questions.text: How high was the altar of incense?
questions.explanation: The altar of incense was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and its height was two cubits.

questions.text: According to whose art did Bezalel make the holy anointing oil and the pure incense?
questions.explanation: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.
